value.signature: async fn relay (state : Relay) -> Result < () , Refusal >

review.body: { let Relay { shim , socket , startup , key , diagnostics , refusal , server_error , } = state ; let result = forward (shim , socket , startup , key , diagnostics , refusal , server_error) . await ; if let Err (cause) = & result { tracing :: warn ! (cause = ? cause , outcome = if matches ! (cause , Refusal :: Transport) { "error" } else { "refusal" } , "store relay refused") ; } result }
review.item_premise: Relay carries the closed-answer slot to the filter, which publishes the first answer before forwarding or ending the stream. The refusal retains that public value without accessing diagnostic bytes.
